notes.title: Patch 0.1.1: Bosses buffed and new Codex entries
The Constellation Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/1fcd976fd774e4e7011247a5397305b9964043a5.png"]


[previewyoutube="Ry94nV9Qhew;full"][/previewyoutube]

✨ The Constellation System ✨
Activate Constellations to add difficulty modifiers to your Journey, in exchange for extra Souls!



🔹 🍷   Crater - The Cup – Flasks only heal 1 Blood now.

🔹 🐦‍⬛   Corvus - The Crow – Enemies attack more frequently and in greater numbers.

🔹 ♊   Gemini - The Twins – Add two random extra Corruptions to this Journey.

🔹 👑  Cepheus - The King – Bosses become stronger and add variation to their attacks.

🔹 ✝️   Crux - The Southern Cross – Bleeding becomes lethal and slightly faster.

🔹 🧭   Pyxis - The Compass – 5 Keys are required to open each Region's gate.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/dc1a2abca3c5759d3d379852be4e607c81517ae2.gif"]



New Constellations will be added in upcoming updates.



⭐  New Weapon - The Star of Yesteryear
A powerful boomerang that generates Ardor the more you deflect it. Charge it by spending Bullets.

Star Upgrades

🔹 🔁  Trickstar – activate the Star to swap positions with it;

🔹 🩸 Bloodstar – activate the Star to detonate a bloody explosion around it;

🔹 🌟  Twinstar – generate the Star faster and enable multiple Stars in the air;



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/f884ab348a012c94162d8ce0fa3525f8c6935cc3.gif"]



Finish a Journey for the second time to unlock the Star.



🙋 New Characters
🔹 💡 The Lamplighter – a lone, affable Lamplighter that may appear during your Journeys and light your path;

🔹 🚬  Jules – a sarcastic assistant to Morrigan, helping you with Bloodstones, Talents and Sins;

🔹 💀   Sir Scully – Morrigan's smith and knight, helping you with Rotskulls, Weapons and Arts;

💎  Capstone Talents
Impactful and dangerous Talents obtained at the end of a Talent Tree. Dramatically change your journey by choosing these Talents.

🔹❤️‍🔥 Heartburn – Gain 100 Max Blood. Lose 75 Blood at the start of every combat.

🔹🔴  Crimson and Scarlet – Can't go over 40% Blood. Recover Blood for all melee damage.

🔹🌕  Eclipse – Double all knockback. Enemies take massive damage from hitting the edges of arenas.

🔹🧵  Deathloom – The String has no cooldown. Lose a Dash usage.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/0e28c97f7ca61e0aabe1a3c7f76b089baa2d725a.gif"]


💎  New Talents
🔹⭐ Starstruck – The Star stuns enemies for 1s.

🔹🪞 Mirrorfold – Deflect the Star to create a Phantom duplicate of it. Shoot a Phantom Star to detonate it.



⚔️  New Art Refinements
🔹Moonslash - Riposte – Riposte deals heavily increased knockback;

🔹Hot Reload - Precise Shot – with your last Bullets, hit an enemy with Precise Shot to recover all your Bullets;

🔹Librarian - Crook – Crook briefly interrupts enemies.

🔹Deathspear - Bayonet – the Bayonet now deals 8 damage instead of 4.



🌠  Achievements
Steam achievements have been added to the game! Acquire new weapons and meet new characters to complete them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/fbffdb617b32fae62a12ccfea004b815cefa4185.png"]

New Achievements will be added in each new update.



Game Improvements
- New Blessing Screen UI;

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/3fbbd0ecc907669344a2cdeeaa0fb7dfa4c5fe67.png"]
Balance Changes
- Sins are now unlocked automatically after unlocking a certain Talent threshold;

- Reduced Talent unlock cost;

- Keys required for each Region reduced to 3;

- After completing 3 Arenas in the same Region, that Region becomes Sanguinary, increasing Bleeding while in their arenas;

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9: Songs in Silk
Patch 0.0.8: Bloom and some good news
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! This small patch features some visual upgrades for the game, adding bloom and glow to attacks!

Also, stay tuned for updates next month! As September approaches, we're going full steam ahead for our next Major Update, featuring a new weapon, new characters and the Constellation System!


Game Improvements
A new Bloom option under Graphics, controlling the amount of glow coming from attacks and white creatures;

Updated the icons for the Gluttony, Envy and Sloth sins;

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/69b1a498649c3c6feb3a5d8dcfe88a02c11ccf96.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/a1059f783c332061cb5a83ae715198fa3fe51ca2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/45aad33f597193410129775535fb54d157e4d52e.png"]


Some good news!
One of (if not the most) popular request we've received so far were Achievements. I knew we were going to implement them, but I didn't quite know when.

Well, I'm happy to announce that Achievements are coming with the Constellation Update! As we update the game, more achievements are going to be added with time, so stay tuned!



Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can!

Have a nice day!

-Dan

notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/2ff5417634a84a40f40cfb9fc351a93b91bcbbfc.png"]
🩸 Early Access Roadmap — BloodRush: Undying Wish
As you battle through immortal hordes and uncover the dark mysteries of BloodRush, we're working hard behind the scenes to bring you exciting new updates that will deepen your experience. Here’s a look at what’s coming:
[hr][/hr]✨ The Constellation Update — September 2025
A brand-new Constellation System that introduces fresh mechanics for progression and customization.

New weapon: Star, designed for those who want to shine in the midst of chaos.

5 New Talents to expand your build options.

New Dialogues and character interactions to enrich the game's lore.

And more surprises to come!
[hr][/hr]🩸 The Neverending Update — December 2025
A New Boss awaits (his identity will be revealed soon...)

New weapon: Blood Cannon, for players who want to paint the battlefield red.

A mysterious New Arena.

A New Act of the Story, expanding the game’s narrative.

And more additional content!
[hr][/hr]🔥 The Inferno Update — Fall 2026
A New Mini-Boss that will push your skills to the limit.

New Challenges and Enemies to conquer.

Additional Talents for even more playstyle variety.

Other improvements and unannounced features.
[hr][/hr]🗡️ The Final Update — Winter 2026
The long-awaited final boss of your journey.

New Weapon, Arena, and Talents.

Story updates to bring the main arc of BloodRush: Undying Wish to a thrilling conclusion.

Plus final touches and bonus content.
[hr][/hr]
⚠️ Please note: This roadmap is subject to change during development. Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Early Access Available Now!
notes.content:
The Early Access is available NOW!
Starting July 1st, you are able to experience the Early Access version of BloodRush: Undying Wish!
[previewyoutube="z0a_KKrhvTY;full"][/previewyoutube]
BloodRush: Undying Wish is an extremely fast-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world. Dash, shoot and strike with ability combos, weaving between enemies like an improvised dance. Death is gone; bring her back. 


New Features on Early Access🌲🌲 The Witchery Woods 🌲🌲
🔹🧙‍♀️ The Witch – A member of the Cult of Eternity, the Witch is a sarcastic and spirited expert in alchemy, necromancy and black magic. Suffering has never been so comical!

🔹😈 The Beast – ...or what's left of it. The Witch's "child" is as dangerous as it looks.

🔹🌲 The Woods – dance in arenas devastated by spikes and fungi - a reflection of the chaotic and free spirit of its dweller.

 
👹 New Enemies
🔹🌊 Ooze – a lumbering slime, result of nefarious experiments, that multiplies itself on death;

🔹🪆 Doll – fragile and fearful enemy that protects itself with an umbrella, pushing the player away;

🔹🤍 Soulmate – an empathic soul that protects another enemy, gently rotating around it. Dies if it distances itself too much from its loved one.

 
⚔️ New Weapons
🔹📔 Gnossis Staff – A mystical Staff that specializes in displacing and manipulating enemies - pulling, pushing and stunning.

🔹⚡ Storm Dragon – A hungry and vengeful Blunderbuss that focuses on quick, potent, short-range damage.

 
🎃 Corruptions
Thanks to the Witch's shenanigans (hehehe), your enemies now transform during your Journey, evolving into more dangerous forms and receiving new powers, such as:

🔹💀 Blinkbones – flying Slitherbones that teleports on taking damage;

🔹🧌 Skullbearer – the Tombfeller becomes more resistant, and carries a Slitherbones on its shoulder;

🔹🪆 Vengeful Doll – a tankier Doll that reflects melee damage back to the player.

 
⚔️ Weapon Aspects
Modify your Weapon during the Journey, transforming or refining your attacks, such as:

🔹Spectral Blade – transform the Blade's third attack into a repeatable dash slice;

🔹Mirror Revolver – deflect projectiles with your Revolver shot;

🔹Wind Dragon – fly back with the Dragon shot, hitting enemies and dealing massive damage on collision.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/2ff5417634a84a40f40cfb9fc351a93b91bcbbfc.png"]

notes.title: A new demo for Bloodrush: Undying Wish!
notes.content:
Evening, everyone! Today we're launching a new demo for Bloodrush: Undying Wish, with a lot of new features...


New Features
Blessing System – Activate passive buffs by binding Souls.
Ardor System – Play with style to increase your rank.
New Ability: Execution – Execute enemies to recover health.
Arena Hub – Choose arena order and receive different rewards for each one.
Visual Improvements to the Tutorial.

+10 New Available Talents, such as...

 Opportunist – Shoot at enemies' backs to deal double damage.
 Weaponmaster – Revolver kills double melee damage.
 Silkcloak – Become invulnerable at Ardor S.


Sins – Choose one at the start of each Journey to dramatically alter your playstyle

 Wrath – Double melee damage at high Ardor, but lose max health.
 Greed – Recover Bullets with every kill, but become more vulnerable.
 Pride – Double Ardor gain, but lose Ardor when taking damage.


Feel free to comment and give feedback on our Steam forums and Discord!

notes.title: First FREE Demo is available!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release of our first free public demo on Steam!

Download now in the Steam page, and don't forget to add to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471390/Bloodrush_Undying_Wish/

Here's a quick list of changes since the last demo (from BIG Festival):

New combos!

 Stringsnap: teleport behind your target without activating the String's cooldown!
 Stringhook: Interrupt and pull your opponents to you!

New upgrades!

 Nine in the Chamber: +3 bullets to shoot down your enemies!
 Third Hate: Destroy the third enemy hit by Crossdash!
 Mirrorguard: Parry projectiles to deflect them with even greater force!
 Parry Shot: Parry enemies at a distance using Precise Shot!

And other improvements!

 General rework of the Blue Flower arena - it's now way bigger and more detailed!
 Torch Rework - hit it to push and damage everyone around it (including yourself)!
 A save system!
 Visual rework of the main character!
 Visual rework of Cassius IV, Last of his Kind!
 New dialog portraits!
 Various bugfixes.
